hook: This S3 cache is full of holes, on purpose.
hookText: An S3 cache full of deliberate holes

beats.say: Berserk, a data store for logs, metrics, traces and evals, caches S3 data on query nodes in sparse files.
Each node stores only the pieces it needs, and punches holes to reclaim disk space as pieces fall out of use. A file can look huge while using little disk.
Workers keep several S3 requests in flight, read ahead, and read directly from the shared cache. It's a trick the author first learned as a sysadmin in 1990.
